'''International relations'''
*[[China–United Kingdom relations]] 
**The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] approves [[China|China]]'s new [[Embassy of China, London|embassy]] at [[London]]'s [[Royal Mint Court]], despite [[national security|security]] concerns. The [[planning permission in the United Kingdom|planning decision]] affirmed [[development plan|development]] compliance, while [[MI5]] raised no objections. The embassy will be the largest Chinese embassy in [[Europe]] upon completion.  [https://www.cnn.com/2026/01/20/uk/uk-china-mega-embassy-royal-mint-court-intl (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Gun laws of Australia]]
**[[2026 Australia gun buyback program]]
***The [[Australia]]n [[Parliament of Australia|parliament]] passes [[Australian legal system|laws]] introducing a nationwide [[gun buyback program]], stricter [[Universal background check|background checks]], and tougher penalties for [[Racial violence in Australia|hate crimes]], following the [[2025 Bondi Beach shooting]] that killed 15 people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australias-lower-house-passes-tougher-gun-control-laws-response-bondi-mass-2026-01-20/ (Reuters)]
*[[War on drugs]]
**[[Thailand|Thai]] authorities announces the end of a 4-month operation to combat [[Illegal drug trade in Thailand|drug trafficking in the country]], resulting in the seizure of 330 million [[methamphetamine]] tablets, the arrests of over 88,000 suspects, and [[asset freezing|frozen assets]] worth [[Thai baht|฿]]3.39B (US$140M). [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/thailand-seizes-over-330-million-methamphetamine-pills-in-4-month-crackdown (''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Portugal|Portuguese]] [[Polícia de Segurança Pública|police]] arrest 37 suspects linked to an [[Far-right politics|ultra-right]] network accused of [[Racism in Portugal|racially motivated]] [[Crime in Portugal#Hate crime|hate crimes]], seizing weapons and [[Neo-Nazism|neo-Nazi]] materials during a nationwide operation targeting {{ill|Grupo 1143|pt}}, whose leader is already imprisoned. [https://www.reuters.com/world/portuguese-police-arrest-37-suspected-ultra-right-militants-2026-01-20/ (Reuters)]

**[[Bulgaria]]n [[President of Bulgaria|president]] [[Rumen Radev]] resigns, marking the first voluntary resignation of the country's president in [[History of Bulgaria (1990–present)|its post-communist history]].
